title: Monica Stamp — Leadership lens
body_md:
**Monica stamp (exact):** Pass only if the beat is about **leadership**, or **developing as a better leader or person** so you can grow your network marketing business.

Opportunity / Rank / Wealth **without** that tie → **rewrite** to leadership / personal development. Growing the person and the leader — not rank-chase.

title: Thesis — Leadership + grow as an NM
body_md:
**Thesis:** Leadership + grow yourself as a network marketer.

Speak to the **top ~5% of NMs** — not joiners. Be **direct** (NM audience doesn’t read between the lines). Avoid vague AI hedges.

title: Do not say
body_md:
**Do not say / do not assume:**
- Viewer is scarred, wounded, or broken
- Mom-shaming / Rachael Bodie–style hookbait
- Vague AI hedges (“gently/quietly disagree”, soft mush)

Dropped on Call #3: mom/Rachael hookbait script.

title: Format DNA check
body_md:
**Format DNA:** Lock hook / format / idea / reward. Shift only messaging · angle · voice.

**Dual audit before camera:**
- **MATCH** — keeps the DNA (hook pattern, beats, idea, reward)
- **PASS** — sounds like Rich Life (thesis, niche words, no banned hooks)

Fail either → rewrite. Both required to film.

title: Locked formats (5)
body_md:
**Locked formats (Call #3):** Reaction · Education · Lists · Interview · Myth-buster.

Stay inside these five when transplanting reference DNA into Rich Life scripts.

title: Review checklist (beside reference)
body_md:
**While watching the reference reel (Resources left / Ref right):**
1. Does the Monica stamp pass?
2. Is the hook locked (same pattern / tension)?
3. Is the body shifted to Rich Life (messaging · angle · voice)?
4. Does the Hub title sync with the script?

All four yes → ready for client / film. Any no → rewrite.
